notes:
{色々|いろいろ} functions as both a na-adjective and adverb, meaning "various" or "in many ways."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {色々|いろいろ}な + noun: various ~ (na-adjective)
- {色々|いろいろ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + verb: in many ways (adverb with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧)
- {色々|いろいろ} + verb: in many ways (adverb without ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {色々|いろいろ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: various people
- {色々|いろいろ}⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧: thanks for everything
- {色々|いろいろ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: it must have been hard in many ways
- {色々|いろいろ}⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to think about various things

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧(な): various (more formal, written)
- ⟦{種々|しゅじゅ}→種々：08730_shuju⟧(の): various (formal, literary)
- ⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧(な): diverse (academic/formal)

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana as いろいろ in casual contexts.
